description: This Java source file defines an Android activity named Grid3 that demonstrates the use of multi-choice selection mode in a GridView. It includes inner classes for the adapter, layout, and multi-choice mode listener, managing app icons and selection states.

classes.name: Grid3
classes.description: Main activity that displays a grid of app icons with multi-selection capabilities.

classes.name: AppsAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter for providing app icon views for the grid.

classes.name: CheckableLayout
classes.description: A custom layout that implements Checkable for managing selection highlight.

classes.name: MultiChoiceModeListener
classes.description: Listener for handling multi-selection modal actions and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads apps, and sets up the grid view.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries installed launcher activities to populate app list.
